pattern: The most consistent tell is safe framing: a complete object, level and centred, with even clearance on all sides and a tidy base. Real cards are bolder, letting heroes run off an edge, such as the lamp post, fan and lighthouse, or bringing them closer at an active angle. Generated cards also add secondary props or scenery around the hero, such as the lighthouse lesson's island, rope and life ring, which split the first read. Other giveaways are off-range occupancy, like a hero sitting low with an empty half of the card. These signals are weak on many test pairs, and box measurements sometimes reflect the object's shape or a bad selection, so most calls here are low confidence.
